QUOTE: "Their initial values are `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_FREE`, which default to stubs (`platform_calloc_uninit` returns NULL, `platform_free_uninit` does nothing). So with `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` on and nothing installed, every allocation fails."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the uninitialised pointer defaults are stubs: calloc returns NULL and free does nothing, so allocation fails rather than falling back.
